sentences.en: He went to Italy with a view to studying literature.
sentences.zh: 他去意大利是为了研究文学。

sentences.en: He puts a lot of his interest in Japanese literature.
sentences.zh: 他对日本文学很感兴趣。

sentences.en: The lecturer spoke generally about American literature and specifically about Faulkner.
sentences.zh: 这位讲师大致谈了美国文学，并具体提到了福克纳。
